statement: Lambda Cloud lists NVIDIA B200 SXM6 on-demand at $6.69-$6.99 per GPU-hour.
why: A published on-demand list rate for the current-generation Blackwell part is the reference price against which neocloud and hyperscaler rental economics are compared.

impact.mechanism: Vendor-published rental levels set the observable cost of renting Blackwell capacity; no baseline or prior level is given on the page, so this is a static level only.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own public list page read directly, but a single secondary source with no prior-period baseline shown.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 3.29 -> 6.69 (tol 1%); sources: lambda.ai
